sources.title: CliDeck README (v2.6.0)
sources.locator: Quick start; Working with sessions; See what agents produce; Work as a team; Local setup; Coming from v1
sources.finding: Local browser workspace for CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, shell) with projects, live status, resume, search, Task Manager, output previews, CliDeck Ask, plugins; localhost only; MIT; Node 22.12+.

sources.title: MIT license
sources.finding: MIT License text.

sources.title: package.json
sources.finding: Version 2.6.0, bin clideck, Node >=22.12, node-pty, ws, xterm.js, mermaid; no cloud SDK dependencies.

sources.title: CLI definition
sources.locator: usage(): agents, ask, show, prompt, annotate, plugins, plugin install
sources.finding: CLI exposes session discovery, ask/steer, preview, prompt, annotate and plugin commands to agents and users against the local engine URL.

sources.title: Agent session guide
sources.finding: Product-supplied instructions tell each agent session to discover peers with clideck agents, ask idle peers, steer working ones and coordinate file ownership.

sources.title: Ask routing
sources.finding: Resolves a target session or project, requires an idle target or --steer, with 10-minute default and 60-minute max timeout.

sources.title: Provider registry
sources.finding: Seven providers: claude-code, antigravity, codex, gemini, opencode, pi and shell.

sources.title: WebSocket origin checks
sources.finding: Only same-host origins are accepted and loopback-bound servers accept loopback origins only.

sources.title: Upgrading to CliDeck 2
sources.locator: Version 2.6; Removed features; Old agent hooks
sources.finding: v2 removed Autopilot, mobile control, LAN binding and legacy plugins; imports v1 data into ~/.clideck-next; removes obsolete v1 agent hooks with private backups.

sources.title: Backup and restore
sources.locator: Settings > General > Backup & restore; Automatic recovery
sources.finding: Backup downloads JSON with settings, projects and session definitions; selective restore; not conversations or files; includes custom command env values.

sources.title: Session archives
sources.finding: Optional archive of conversation events as JSONL in a user-chosen folder.

sources.title: Plugin SDK
sources.finding: v2 plugin SDK with folder-based plugins under the data directory, CLI commands and settings.

sources.title: Git Changes plugin
sources.finding: Read-only panel showing uncommitted and since-base changes for a session repository or worktree; never stages or commits.

sources.title: Context usage
sources.finding: Shows per-session context-window usage (used tokens, window, percent) for supported agents; no cost data.

sources.title: Task Manager
sources.finding: Lists agent process trees with CPU and memory per project and lets the user stop a job (macOS and Linux).

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Only outbound product request found: bounded npm registry check for a newer version; nothing is installed automatically.

sources.title: Claude hook settings
sources.finding: Generates per-session Claude Code settings with local command hooks and a statusLine command pointing at the local engine.

sources.title: PTY launcher
sources.finding: Each session is a node-pty process with provider environment variables sanitized.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 162 stars, MIT, homepage https://clideck.dev, pushed 2026-10-30; latest release v2.6.0 (2026-10-30), 30 releases.

sources.title: CliDeck website
sources.finding: Home lists Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode, projects, notifications and ask; Autopilot and Mobile pages are explicitly marked CliDeck 1.x only and not available in 2.x; a Google Workspace feature is described as coming, off by default.

sources.title: CliDeck Mobile page
sources.finding: Describes a QR-connected browser remote with an encrypted relay for 1.x, marked not available in 2.x; free with no account.
